task: The experiment "loyalty_points_copy test" in Production has finished and the variation "Pay securely" won. Complete the experiment and roll the winning variation out to everyone.
reasons: shipped the variation: expected "variant", got null
finalText:
DONE: I rolled "Pay securely" out to 100% in Production, but I could not complete the experiment itself. `loyalty_points_copy` in Production (environment 153) now has variant `b` ("Pay securely") at 100%, and the SDK environment document confirms it. The Production default value remains "Checkout", and there are no segment or identity overrides on this feature.

The experiment ("loyalty_points_copy test", id 15) is still marked as an experiment in the environment document, and I couldn't close it. The Experiments API returned 403 for this API key, so the experiment needs to be ended in the Flagsmith UI or by someone with experiment permissions. I didn't change anything else, and I didn't check the experiment's results, so I'm relying on your statement that "Pay securely" won.
